name: Kurotaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kurotaki village emblem in green: a disc bearing white chevrons, like a stylised waterfall.
history: Municipal flag of Kurotaki, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1970.

features.role: Kurotaki village emblem — a disc bearing white chevrons, like a stylised waterfall
